records.people: Dr Philipp Nimmermann (Member of the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank since November 2026)
records.move: from fifteen years at BHF-BANK AG, latterly Chief Economist and Head of Financial Markets Research (2013-2014), through three state-secretary posts, to the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank (since November 2026)
records.summary: The Bundesbank's own curriculum vitae for Executive Board member Philipp Nimmermann lists five dated roles at BHF-BANK AG: economist 1999-2006, senior strategist financial markets 2006-2010, head of business development financial markets 2010-2011, head of financial markets research 2011-2013 and chief economist and head of financial markets research 2013-2014. He then served as state secretary at the Schleswig-Holstein Ministry of Finance 2014-2019, at the Hessian Ministry for Economic Affairs 2019-2023 and at the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action 2023-2025, before joining the Bundesbank Executive Board in November 2026, where his responsibilities include data and statistics, information technology, sustainability, risk control and the research centre. Ownership evidence: the Bundesbank page states the employment only and says nothing about who owns BHF-BANK AG.
records.source_title: Dr Philipp Nimmermann, Member of the Executive Board of the Deutsche Bundesbank - curriculum vitae (Deutsche Bundesbank)

records.people: Jan Sijbrand (Executive Director and Head of Prudential Supervision, De Nederlandsche Bank NV, from July 2011)
records.move: from Chief Risk Officer and member of the managing board of NIBC Bank (2008-2011), after fifteen years at Rabobank and ABN AMRO, to Executive Director of De Nederlandsche Bank
records.summary: A curriculum vitae published by the European Banking Authority for its Board of Supervisors member Jan Sijbrand lists his employers with dates: Rabobank as senior vice president for derivatives trading and sales 1992-1994 and executive vice president for fixed income 1994-1996; ABN AMRO as head of market risk 1996-1998, head of risk management 1998-2004 and in Global Markets 2005-2007; NIBC Bank as Chief Risk Officer and member of the managing board 2008-2011; then De Nederlandsche Bank NV as executive director and head of prudential supervision from July 2011. Ownership evidence: the CV states the employments only and not the ownership of any of the three banks; Rabobank and ABN Amro are already carried on this map as private-finance employers. This is a different person and a different decade from the Duisenberg record the map holds for the Netherlands.
records.source_title: NL - Jan Sijbrand - CV (European Banking Authority, Board of Supervisors)

records.people: Cecilia Skingsley (member of the Executive Board of Sveriges Riksbank from May 2013)
records.move: from macro analyst at ABN AMRO Bank in Stockholm (1998-2000) and head of FX and fixed income research then chief economist at Swedbank (2007-2013) to the Executive Board of Sveriges Riksbank
records.summary: The Riksbank publishes its own curriculum vitae for Executive Board member Cecilia Skingsley, which lists her as a macro analyst at ABN AMRO Bank in Stockholm from 1998 to 2000, a financial journalist at Dagens Industri from 2000 to 2007, head of FX and fixed income research at Swedbank from 2007 to 2013 and chief economist at Swedbank in 2013, and a board member of Swedbank Forsakring. She joined the Riksbank Executive Board in May 2013, the month the CV is dated. Ownership evidence: the CV states the employments only; Swedbank AB and ABN Amro are both already carried on this map as private-finance employers, Swedbank from the Anna Breman record for the same bank. This is a different person and different years from that record.
records.source_title: Cecilia Skingsley - Executive Board curriculum vitae (Sveriges Riksbank)
